title: HavoK Mod
description:
[Non Official Mod]
Discover the best Fortnite team with this mod!
body:
This mod is a non-official mod about the french Esport Fortnite Team: HavoK!
If you want to discover the team : [https://teamhavok.fr/](https://teamhavok.fr/)

- 👕 Play with your favorite jerseys!
  All of the clothes from the first jerseys to the last like hoodies or the Prestige one are available!
- 🔫 Fight with the Havoc Shotgun!
  Discover the weapon which inspired the name of the first European structure!
- 🏳️ Support players with custom flags and even more!
  Place flag from countries where the players are coming to all around your world or listen the music while chilling in your house!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
❗If you find issues or if you are a developper who wants to help me, contact me :
- On Discord : fire_fish_
- On X (formerly Twitter) : Fishy_Au_Carre

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
To develop this mod, I used :
- MCreator to develop everything
- Paintnet to create every textures
- Blockbench to create the 3d models

Thanks to :
- NoVaX who allowed me to use his song
- All the HavoK team which inspired me to create this
